name: wp-soli-event-plugin
description: Recurring event management for concerts, rehearsals, and performances.

scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin/languages/soli-event.pot --domain=soli-event --exclude=node_modules,build,e2e
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin/languages
scripts.i18n:make-json: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin/languages --no-purge --use-map=wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin/i18n-map.json && wp-env run cli wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin/languages --no-purge --use-map=wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-event-plugin/i18n-map-frontend.json
scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:make-pot && npm run i18n:make-mo && npm run i18n:make-json

wordpress._comment: Oldest supported WordPress branch. The e2e suite runs against the newest patch of this branch as well as the newest release, and the release workflows stamp it into the plugin's 'requires'. Raise it when production no longer runs it.
